package.name: fus_targeting_gui
package.description: Standalone GUI for transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) acoustic characterization. Loads a skull mesh, click a point on its surface, and send the robot's end effector there via MoveIt. Contains no robot-specific logic. Every robot-facing detail (planning group, base and tip frame, mesh registration pose) comes from config.yaml, so pointing this at a different, already-calibrated arm is a config change, not a code change. This is the first ament_python package in this workspace, since everything else is C++ and ament_cmake. It talks to MoveIt via pymoveit2 rather than moveit_py, which is not installed here.
